data.body: S2 (f184) plan-review v1: BLOCK (blocking=5 advisory=14). Findings all legitimate and the SAME CLASS as the S1 defect (under-enumerated scope) but caught pre-implementation. Remediated: (1) added the Bedrock test case + AC — Bedrock silently losing cache settings is S2s whole motivation yet nothing asserted it; (2) enumerated ALL FOUR affected test files by grepping every call site — reviewer found test_structured.py and a SECOND cache test in test_pydantic_ai_runner.py; I additionally found a FOURTH site it missed, tests/interfaces/store/test_execution_mode_dispatch.py:90 patching _anthropic_cache_settings (same file S1 had to fix); (3) resolved the G6/E2 binary design choice definitively — ONE cache_settings_for(caps) function, _anthropic_cache_settings DELETED; (4) named the exact keys: bedrock_cache_instructions/bedrock_cache_tool_definitions on BedrockModelSettings (advisory T1 was RIGHT that BedrockConverseModelSettings does not exist — verified absent); (5) fixed the wrong line citation (cache gate is runner.py:341, not :316 which is the toolset-filter line); (6) resolved the G7 conflict with S1s ATTESTED providers.py<300 LOC criterion by putting capabilities in a NEW leaf module src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py (providers.py already 225 LOC) rather than silently busting a signed AC; (7) added make test (not tests/unit) to the ACs — the S1 lesson. OPERATOR DIRECTION on supports_thinking: I had dropped it per advisories A1/T8 as a consumer-less field. Operator flagged it matters for FUTURE AUDITABILITY (chain-of-thought is not persisted today but may become a requirement). Verified they are right and it is stronger than speculative: S5 (343b) provenance payload is {provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, capabilities} where capabilities IS this record verbatim, so every dropped field is permanently absent from a SIGNED verdict artifact and adding it post-S5 changes an already-signed payload shape. RESTORED supports_thinking with the processing protocol T8 actually asked for: derived from ModelProfile.supports_thinking; consumer is S5 provenance, NOT control flow; output_mode() still takes the caller-supplied thinking bool because the Anthropic 400 is a property of the CALL not the model. Added an AC asserting output_mode does NOT consult it, so the provenance field cannot silently become a control-flow input.
